title: I am making an open-source text-to-character pipeline
author: SamMaliblahblah
selftext:
Character Factory is a free, open-source, locally-run text-to-3D character pipeline. Prompt in, rigged character out.

It uses MHR as the base mesh and a series of custom Flux.2 Klein loras to generate the textures. Characters are fully rigged with face blendshapes, clothes, shoes, hair.

There is a lot built around it already (mcp, local web app, api, unity package) that can be found here:

[https://github.com/character-factory/character-factory](https://github.com/character-factory/character-factory)

Visually it has a way to go, but it's useful enough now that I think it's worth sharing.
